posts.description: Photo by Rubenz Arizta on Unsplash The rise of cable, satellite and streaming over the past 20 years has made over-the-air television appear as a footnote of the information age, yet it remains one of the last distribution mediums operated in the public interest; unencumbered by rising prices, specialized equipment or unwatchable buffering during live sports and new releases. posts.title: Housing is a human right. Let’s start acting like it.
posts.description: Austin is in a housing crisis. posts.title: I'm running for Travis County commissioner
posts.description: Hey y’all - I’m running for Travis County commissioner to lower the skyrocketing cost of living in Travis County, and it’s going to be an uphill battle the whole way. We’re fighting the Democratic Party establishment on their home turf - the county commission.
